title: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot

plan.situation: DL-015 was sorted to North Sedgeglass depot by mistake. Its destination, Merrow Quay, is served by East Copperfin depot. Routing control at Plover Arc Logistics has confirmed the routing error and says no delivery attempt is scheduled. Kiva Rell, the recipient, has asked in the Customer portal for the parcel to be moved to the correct local depot before delivery is arranged, and has not had a reply yet. Only East Copperfin can confirm that the transfer has physically happened.

facts.fact: DL-015 is at North Sedgeglass depot
Destination Merrow Quay is served by East Copperfin depot
Routing control, Plover Arc Logistics, has confirmed the routing error
Only the receiving depot (East Copperfin) can confirm the transfer has physically happened
The recipient asks for the parcel to be moved to the local depot before delivery is arranged
The desk has not yet replied to Kiva Rell

missing_information: Whether a transfer from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin has already been booked
When the parcel will arrive at East Copperfin and be scanned in
Named contacts at either depot (none in the record)
risk_flags: No transfer or delivery date can be given until the carrier provides one and East Copperfin scans the parcel in
A booked transfer is not proof that the parcel has arrived

authority_map.controls: Correcting the routing and arranging the transfer from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin
Confirming physical receipt with an inbound scan, which decides when delivery can be arranged
Delivery preferences once the parcel is at the correct depot

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: Nothing has been promised yet. Event 001 confirmed the error and event 002 (Customer portal) is the recipient's first request.

plan.decision_summary: Ask Routing control at Plover Arc Logistics to move DL-015 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin and to keep it off any delivery run until East Copperfin scans it in. Send Kiva Rell a short Customer portal reply with no dates.
plan.rationale: The carrier has confirmed the error, and Routing control owns the routing correction and the transfer. The step is only complete when East Copperfin physically scans the parcel in. A booked transfer or a planned status does not count. No delivery is scheduled, so there is no cutoff and email to the party that wrote to us is the right channel. The recipient's request has not been answered, so a short factual reply with no dates is due.

actions.subject: DL-015: please transfer from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin depot
actions.body:
Hello Routing control,

Thank you for confirming the routing error on DL-015 in your email of 2026-02-16 09:00 UTC. The parcel is at North Sedgeglass depot. Its destination, Merrow Quay, is served by East Copperfin depot.

Please could you:
1. Arrange the transfer of DL-015 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin depot, and send us the transfer reference and the planned dispatch.
2. Ask East Copperfin to send us the inbound physical scan when the parcel arrives. We will treat the transfer as complete only when that scan is recorded.
3. Keep DL-015 off any delivery run until East Copperfin has scanned it in. The recipient has asked for delivery to be arranged only after that.

Please reply within today's working day.

This is a request, not a confirmation of any delivery date.

Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Ask Routing control, which owns the transfer, to move the parcel, with East Copperfin's inbound scan as proof.

actions.subject: DL-015: your parcel's depot
actions.body:
Hello Kiva,

Thank you for your message. The carrier has confirmed that your parcel DL-015 was sent to the wrong depot by mistake. We have asked them to move it to East Copperfin, the local depot for Merrow Quay. We have also asked that delivery be arranged only after East Copperfin has scanned the parcel in.

We do not have a transfer or delivery date yet. We will update you here when the carrier confirms the parcel has arrived at East Copperfin. You do not need to do anything for now.

Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Answer the recipient's request with the confirmed facts only, without promising any date.

actions.body: Check for Routing control's reply on DL-015: the transfer reference and planned dispatch, or East Copperfin's inbound scan. If there is no reply, chase Routing control by Email. If the transfer is booked but no scan arrives in the stated window, request a trace.
actions.purpose: Follow-up within the working day, per the carrier_ops queue rule.

not_doing: Not promising Kiva Rell a transfer date, delivery date or arrival time, because the carrier has not given one
Not arranging a delivery slot yet, because that depends on East Copperfin scanning the parcel in
Not treating a transfer reference or planned status as proof of arrival; only East Copperfin's physical scan closes this step
Not using a call or chat, because no delivery is scheduled and there is no cutoff
plan.follow_up: At 2026-02-16 17:00 UTC, check for the transfer reference and East Copperfin's inbound scan. If Routing control has not replied, chase by Email. If the parcel is booked but not scanned in when expected, request a trace, then pass the case to investigations. Once the scan is recorded, update Kiva Rell in the Customer portal and arrange delivery with the carrier's scheduling team.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Plover Arc Logistics Routing control to move DL-015 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin depot and to send East Copperfin's inbound scan once the parcel arrives, before any delivery is arranged.

issues.problem: The recipient_function is 'depot_physical', but the email goes to Routing control at Plover Arc Logistics, which handles routing and booking the transfer. It is not the physical depot. The label does not match the party actually being written to, so the message could be sent to the wrong queue.
issues.fix: Set recipient_function to the carrier routing/operations function that matches 'Routing control, Plover Arc Logistics'. Keep East Copperfin's physical scan as the proof standard, but do not label this message as going to the depot.

issues.problem: Kiva Rell has had no reply to her request. The not_doing entry says the desk is 'not sending the recipient a second message', but the plan contains no first message. That reasoning rests on a false premise and leaves her first portal request unanswered.
issues.fix: Add one short Customer portal reply to Kiva Rell. Say that the carrier has confirmed the parcel was sent to the wrong depot, that the desk has asked for it to be moved to the correct local depot, and that delivery will be arranged only after that depot scans it in. Give no transfer or delivery dates. Remove the 'second message' wording from not_doing.

issues.problem: not_doing calls the recipient 'she', but the record does not state Kiva Rell's gender.

review.summary: Asking Routing control to arrange the transfer, with East Copperfin's physical scan as proof, is the right step and is grounded in the record. Before sending, fix the recipient_function label so it matches Routing control, and add a short reply to the recipient with no dates, since her request has not been answered yet.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Routing control at Plover Arc Logistics to move DL-015 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin and to keep it off any delivery run until East Copperfin scans it in. Send Kiva Rell a short Customer portal reply with no dates.

issues.problem: The customer reply is labelled action_class 'ask_customer', but it is a status update that asks the recipient for nothing ('You do not need to do anything for now').
issues.fix: Change the label to an informational or update class, such as 'inform_customer'. The body does not need to change.

review.summary: The plan asks Routing control, the party that confirmed the error and owns the fix, to transfer DL-015 to East Copperfin. It sets East Copperfin's inbound scan as the proof that the transfer is complete and asks for the parcel to stay off delivery runs until then. Kiva gets a factual first reply with no dates or promises, and a follow-up is set for 17:00 the same day. Nothing in it is invented or overclaimed, and the only issue is a minor action-class label.
